# oriz Name

> Free client-side name generator — brands, products, startups, usernames, repo names — with vibe controls. 100% in-browser, no signup, no upload. AI-assisted via g4f (keyless) with graceful fallback.

## App
- [Live app](https://name.oriz.in): generate names by vibe, category, and style
- [About / info](https://chirag127.github.io/oriz-name/)

## Features
- Brand / product / startup / username / repo-name generation
- Vibe + style controls (playful, technical, minimal, etc.)
- Heuristic .com-style availability hints (links out to verify)
- AI name + tagline suggestions (optional, degrades if AI unavailable)
